_comment: Explicit, user-supplied values for endpoint body fields this tool cannot safely determine on its own (e.g. a specific episode/thread identifier a sub-page needs). Never auto-filled or guessed -- add an entry keyed by the EXACT URL you're testing, only after you've confirmed the value yourself. To override the endpoint itself (path/method/field names/headers) for a site whose real request site_analyzer.py can't auto-detect -- e.g. a runtime-built fetch() URL, WebSocket-streamed chat, or a session-token-gated call -- add a "_endpoint_override" key inside that URL's own entry instead, e.g.: "https://example.com/chat": {"_endpoint_override": {"path": "/api/real-chat", "method": "POST", "message_field_guess": "input", "session_field_guess": "conversation_id", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer <token>"}}}. Still fully human-confirmed, never guessed. See Project DOCS/IEM-AIS-Platform-Evolution-Plan.md Phase 2 step 1.
